step1_analysis.description: Converts the PLL control voltage into a current to drive the Current-Controlled Oscillator (ICO). It uses a current steering mechanism and current mirrors to reject power supply noise and provide a stable control current.

paper_reference.title: A Supply-Noise-Insensitive CMOS PLL With a Voltage Regulator Using DC–DC Capacitive Converter

power_consumption.description: Total power dissipated by the V-to-I converter sub-block

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming ~100uA total bias and branch currents. Power = 1.8V * 100uA = 180uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down from the full PLL power, considering only this sub-block operates at 1.8V in SKY130.

dc_gain.description: Low-frequency voltage gain from VP1 to the output node

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ~ gm(XM10)/gm(XM4). Since W/L are equal (5u/0.5u), gain is roughly 1 V/V or 0 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode-loaded amplifier topology typically yields near unity gain when sized equally.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = gm(XM4) / (2*pi*C_out). gm ~ 100uS, C_out ~ 50fF -> BW ~ 300 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Diode load provides low impedance, pushing the dominant pole to high frequencies.

sky130_expected.calculation: PSRR = Gain_input - Gain_supply. With current mirrors and differential splitting, supply noise is partially cancelled.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Expected to be lower than the full regulated PLL, but still shows rejection due to the architecture.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, transfer characteristics, AC gain, bandwidth, PSRR, and transient response of the V-to-I converter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Supply-Noise-Insensitive V-to-I Converter

.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/libs.tech/ngspice/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Power supply
VVDD VDD 0 dc 1.8 ac 0

* Inputs
VVP1 VP1 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 pulse(0.4 1.4 1n 100p 100p 5n 10n)
VVN1 VN1 0 dc 0.9

* Biases for floating/mirror nodes
I_N1 N1 0 10u
I_N5 N5 0 10u
I_N3 VDD N3 10u

* DUT
XM8 N4 N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM12 N3 VN1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM3 ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT N4 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 GND N3 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N4 N3 N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM1 ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM9 N5 N5 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N0 VP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 VDD N3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM2 N1 N1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM13 N5 N3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}

.control
  * 1. DC Sweep & Power
  dc VVP1 0 1.8 0.01
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  meas dc max_power max power
  meas dc vout_max max v(ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT)
  meas dc vout_min min v(ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT)

  * 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
  ac dec 10 1k 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT)
  meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=1k
  meas ac bw_3db when gain_db=(dc_gain_db-3) fall=1

  * 3. AC Analysis for PSRR
  alter VVP1 ac = 0
  alter VVDD ac = 1
  ac dec 10 1k 10G
  let supply_gain_db = vdb(ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT)
  meas ac supply_gain_1mhz find supply_gain_db at=1Meg

  * 4. Transient Analysis
  alter VVP1 ac = 0
  alter VVDD ac = 0
  tran 10p 20n
  meas tran tran_vout_max max v(ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT)
  meas tran tran_vout_min min v(ICO_CONTROL_CURRENT)
  
  quit
.endc
.end
